name: Committing Adultery
overview: Scripture clearly commands against committing adultery, as stated in Exodus 20:14 and reiterated by Christ in Matthew 5:27. The seriousness of this sin is emphasized in Leviticus 20:10, where both the adulterer and adulteress face severe consequences. Jesus deepens this understanding by teaching that even lustful intent is equivalent to adultery in the heart (Matthew 5:28), highlighting the internal nature of sin. Furthermore, Matthew 5:32 warns that causing divorce except for fornication leads to adultery, underscoring the sanctity of marriage and faithfulness in God's design.
